description: This file defines API routes for managing itinerary days and activities within a travel planning FastAPI application. It provides CRUD endpoints for itinerary days and activities, including functions to convert ORM objects to response schemas, and handles authorization and database interactions.

methods.name: ActivityResponse _activity_to_response(act: Activity)
methods.description: Converts an Activity ORM object to an ActivityResponse schema.

methods.name: ItineraryDayResponse _day_to_response(day: ItineraryDay)
methods.description: Converts an ItineraryDay ORM object to an ItineraryDayResponse schema.

methods.name: list_itinerary_days( trip_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all itinerary days for a specific trip.

methods.name: create_itinerary_day( trip_id: str, payload: ItineraryDayPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates a new itinerary day for a trip, ensuring no duplicate day numbers.

methods.name: delete_itinerary_day( trip_id: str, day_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified itinerary day and its associated activities.

methods.name: time _parse_time(time_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a time string in HH:MM format into a time object.

methods.name: create_activity( trip_id: str, day_id: str, payload: ActivityPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates a new activity associated with an itinerary day.

methods.name: update_activity( trip_id: str, day_id: str, activity_id: str, payload: ActivityPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates details of an existing activity.

methods.name: delete_activity( trip_id: str, day_id: str, activity_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified activity from an itinerary day.
